sourceTitle: A treatise on foreign teas Abstracted from an ingenious work, lately published, entitled An essay on the nerves
description: "A Treatise on Foreign Teas" by Hugh Smith is a scientific publication likely written in the late 18th century. The text delves into the investigation of the properties and effects of foreign teas, particularly those sourced from India and China, arguing for their harmful consequences on human health, especially related to the nervous system.
